Accessibility

We want everyone to be able to find us, learn about Faith Life and get in touch, whatever their abilities or devices.

Our goal

We aim for this website to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA, in line with The Accessibility for Manitobans Act and its standard for accessible information and communication.

This is ongoing work. The site has not yet had a formal accessibility audit, and we will keep improving it.

What we’ve done

  • Every page works with a keyboard, with a visible outline showing where you are, and a “Skip to content” link at the top.
  • Pages use clear headings, descriptive link text, and labels on every form field.
  • Photos have text descriptions for screen readers.
  • Text and buttons are sized and coloured for readable contrast, and the site adapts to phones, tablets and computers.
  • If your device is set to reduce motion, animations are turned off.
  • A Pause animations button in the footer of every page stops the moving words and the photo slideshow. Your choice is remembered on that device.

Known limits

  • The Spotify player and the Google map are provided by those companies, and we can’t fully control how accessible they are. Every message is also available by opening Spotify directly, and our address and directions are written out on the Contact and Plan your visit pages.
  • Some announcements are shared as poster images. Their details are always written out as text on the What’s on page.

Ask for another format

If you need information from this website in another format, such as large print, a plain text version, or read aloud over the phone, or if something on the site doesn’t work for you, please tell us. We will respond as soon as we can.

  • Through the contact page
  • In person on a Sunday: any usher or pastor can help
  • By mail to 427 Matheson Avenue, Winnipeg, Manitoba R2V 3A7
